dct_title_s: Panama – LATAM Regional Mapatón 2026 – Mapped Buildings
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains building footprints mapped in OpenStreetMap as part of the LATAM Regional Mapatón 2026 in Panama. The data were generated by volunteers participating in the regional mapping campaign conducted from 13 June to 31 July 2026. The mapping focused on priority areas identified according to disaster risk exposure and vulnerability. The resulting open geospatial data can support disaster preparedness, risk analysis, local planning and climate change adaptation.
